title: 2025 yil: O'zbekiston ilk bor jahon chempionatiga chiqdi

scenes.text: Ko'p yil yaqin kelib, maqsadga yetolmaganmisan?
scenes.keywords: football player running alone stadium night

scenes.text: O'zbekiston terma jamoasi uzoq yillar jahon chempionatiga chiqa olmadi.
2025 yil 5 iyunda Birlashgan Arab Amirliklari bilan 0:0 durang o'ynadi.
scenes.keywords: football match players sprinting stadium lights

scenes.text: Bu natija O'zbekistonga tarixidagi ilk jahon chempionati yo'llanmasini berdi.
scenes.keywords: football team celebrating on pitch fans cheering

scenes.text: Sen uchun nima qiyinroq: kutishmi yoki qayta urinishmi?

description: 2025 yil 5 iyunda O'zbekiston terma jamoasi Abu-Dabida BAA bilan 0:0 durang o'ynab, tarixida ilk bor jahon chempionatiga yo'llanma oldi. Uzoq kutish behuda bo'lmadi.
source: FIFA: Uzbekistan qualify for FIFA World Cup 26 for the first time after 0-0 draw with United Arab Emirates, Abu Dhabi, 5 June 2025 (fifa.com; also AFC, the-afc.com; Reuters / AP match reports, 5 June 2025).
